unmapped_blocks.text: SKILLS
Strategic and results-driven SAP EWM consultant with experience in managing multiple warehouses, client relation
and configure scenarios. Excellent exposure of working in complex projects and complicated designs with multiple systems
and interfaces closely working with SAP. Equipped with excellent communication skills, work ethics and possesses a strong
sense of leadership.
Application Development Analyst (SAP EWM), Accenture
July 2022 – Present
Client: Leading Textile firm based out of Europe and Asia Pacific Market.
Experience on End–To–End Test Process, Regressions, Smoke, Functional, Automation
Responsible: Application built to transfer files from inbound to outbound and vice-versa
Test Strategy / Test Planning.
Worked in the post-implementation phase to support the go-live in a new warehouse Delivered
Providing automation ideas that helped to reduce 600+ manual effort hours.
Knowledge and experience in warehouse process like Inbound, Outbound, Crossdocking, wave management,
Internal Process (Replenishment, Scrapping, Physical Inventory)
EWM POC for 4 Technical go-live and 1 store go-live.
Total Implementations done is 1.
Application Development Associate (MuleSoft), Accenture
Nov 2020 – June 2022
Client: Unilever (Europe, U2k2)
Experience in mapping Business Processes to SAP in distributed environment.
Prepare Functional Design Document
Develop Code and Execute Test case through sample files provided.
Preparing reports daily basis for testing the code in quality env
Responsible for training end user in understanding process and providing work arounds.
Responsible for implementing, testing and documenting functional specification of changes in system.
MuleSoft POC for 4 Technical go-live
